comments: thumbTommy plays a couple of tracks from self released cassettes. Savage Hearts cassette inlay.

"For the first time in the history of this programme" Tommy puts on the wrong track in the Friday Night Connection because he reads the label incorrectly and has to waffle while he re-cues the record.
First appearance of the "Staff Selection" feature. Tony's choice - Eric Clapton. Tommy's choice - Frank Marino.
